name: diasposwap
description: DiaspoSwap - community transfer-compensation simulator (simulation mode only, no real money)

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/api/tsconfig.json --noEmit && npm --workspace apps/mobile run typecheck
scripts.mobile:web:export: npm --workspace apps/mobile exec expo export -- --platform web --output-dir dist
scripts.e2e:web: mkdir -p .e2e-shots && node packages/testing/e2e-web.cjs apps/mobile/dist .e2e-shots light && node packages/testing/e2e-web.cjs apps/mobile/dist .e2e-shots dark
